title: Greek Pastry Bites
description: Easy-to-make pastry bites filled with a delicious greek yogurt and honey mixture, perfect for a quick snack.
instructions: Roll out the thawed pastry and cut into small squares.
In a bowl, mix together the Greek yogurt, honey, lemon zest, and vanilla extract.
Place a small spoonful of the yogurt mixture in the center of each pastry square.
Fold the pastry squares in half to form triangles and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with a little water and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
